title: 互斥运行时资源的所有权感知切换
summary: 共享同一 GPU/端口/互斥组的运行时不能只按“谁正在运行”处理；Supervisor 只能自动停止自己拥有的进程，对健康但外部拥有的冲突运行时必须拒绝越权终止并要求显式交接。
principles: Exclusive-resource conflicts are modeled explicitly with an exclusive_group or equivalent relation.
A supervisor may automatically stop only processes it owns.
A healthy conflicting runtime outside the supervisor causes a conflict error rather than an implicit kill.
Restart verifies that the endpoint actually became unowned/unhealthy before starting a replacement.
Managed and external runtimes share health semantics but not lifecycle authority.
